strings.en:
FIELD REPORT: OLMAKHAN

No idea why I'm doing this. Haven't done one of these since...

A long time.

Always was the best way to get my thoughts down, like I'm doing a report for Rytlock or something.

So, Olmakhan.

They split from the charr a long time ago, came down from Ascalon while the Flame Legion was still ruining things up there. Spent a lot of time on the run, learned to do things differently.
First thing I noticed: no fahrars. Cubs are collectively raised by the village, where the cubs learn to hunt and fish, but also to play. They have no warbands because there is no war. The only battle they know is the one against the Inquest and their experiments. They live in harmony with nature.

No fahrars. No warbands. No gladiums. Everyone is part of the tribe. Everyone has their role. Everyone is needed. Everyone is wanted.

It sounds good. Too good, honestly.

END FIELD REPORT

strings.en:
The commander is off resting below deck. Even with the good weather we have starting out, the crew is a bit quieter than usual. Suppose they're not used to ferrying an expedition of non-corsairs across an ocean, but more than that, the presence of Isgarren has them at a bit of a loss.  

Can't imagine why. Sure, he's some big-time wizard or whatever the alliance says, but there's something about him—his seemingly unbothered demeanor, the distant look in his eyes. Had a grandmother like that. Many of the Sly women get quiet and reflective in their later years, holding things close to the chest. Maybe that's just getting old, though.  

***  

After dodging beasts, weaving through brume and boulder, we've done it. We've reached Castora! Not even Margrid or the storied Margonite sailors laid eyes on this land before their fall. I'm doing what I can to salve Canach's bruised ego after losing the Martingale. For all our friendly bickering, it's no easy thing, losing your first ship. I learned that lesson young, and so has he, I guess. I'm not actually sure how old secondborn are.  

We've made contact with some locals, descendants of castaways from over the years and more recent additions. Seems the Inquest have already made an impression out here. I think it's about time we let them know we've arrived.  

***  

A few weeks inland and I already miss the coast. If the seers were so powerful, why couldn't they have built a beach temple? Mellaggan's left fin, if another mosquito bites me, I'm burning this whole forest to the ground.  

Maybe it's the humidity and the bugs, or maybe it's Vloxx dodging our advances at every angle, but I'm beat. Can't wait to kick up my boots at Canach's bar when this wild raptor chase is done. You know, before I have to perform my Captain's Council duties. Gods, it never ends...
